interpretationPolicy: The mapped names and inspected Witchery pages/images contribute only coarse clothing, mining and trading tool, rank, posture, palette, and material cues. All four Warlockery creatures remain unmistakably penguin-bodied, and every atlas pixel, cube, pivot, hierarchy, UV layout, proportion, costume arrangement, and animation is independently authored. No Witchery, Bewitchment, vanilla, or third-party model, texture, code, geometry, face, anatomy, pixel pattern, proportion system, tool placement, or exact appearance is reproduced or imitated.

research.excludedFromInterpretation: The exact humanoid body, head, face, ears, nose, texture, proportions, colors, pose, clothing layout, tool placement, pixel pattern, and geometry were not used. Penguin anatomy remains the controlling silhouette.

research.researchNote: No distinct Witchery Kobold entity page or character image was located.
